title: BloomyHaven — Floral E-Commerce & Gift Boutique
short_desc: Handcrafted floral e-commerce platform with curated bouquet collections, occasion-based gift categories, and custom administrative CMS orders desk.
full_desc: BloomyHaven is a modern floral boutique web application built for boutique flower retailers. It features dynamic bouquet catalog filtering, fresh cut flower box ordering, responsive customer checkout, and a comprehensive administrative CMS control center. The back-office dashboard allows store managers to manage floral categories, update inventory stocks, process customer delivery orders, and oversee customer inquiries. Engineered with procedural and object-oriented PHP and structured relational MySQL schema (bloomy_haven.sql).

title: VogueVibe Fashion — Multi-Tier Apparel & Supplier Platform
short_desc: Commercial garment e-commerce platform equipped with customer shopping cart workflows, supplier business approval desk, and production batch tracking.
full_desc: VogueVibe Fashion is a multi-tier apparel e-commerce system bridging consumers with garment manufacturers. Alongside a modern responsive consumer storefront with apparel categories and shopping cart checkouts, it features an enterprise administrative desk. Administrators can verify and approve textile and garment suppliers, register production batches, audit fabric specifications, and manage warehouse dispatch records. Engineered with PHP and relational MySQL (web_project.sql).

title: Future Minds — A/L Tuition Class & Academic Management System
short_desc: Comprehensive Advanced Level tuition institute management system featuring a 12-lecturer faculty directory, academic timetables, online exams, PDF study material delivery, and automated attendance tracking.
full_desc: Future Minds is an enterprise educational and tuition institute management platform engineered for Sri Lankan Advanced Level educational institutes. The system coordinates operations across multiple academic streams including Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Combined Mathematics, ICT, and Arts. Features include a dynamic faculty directory showcasing top national lecturers (e.g., Dinesh Muthugala, Darshana Ukuwela, Tissa Jananayake, Amith Pussella) with credentials and subject details, multi-batch timetable scheduling, computer-based online examination testing, secure monthly PDF study material distribution, barcode/ID attendance tracking, and PayHere bank slip approval workflows. Powered by a normalized 18-table relational database and zero-configuration embedded engine.

title: The Grand Horizon — Luxury Hotel & Suites ERP Management System
short_desc: Production-grade hospitality web ERP with 4-tier RBAC authentication, overlapping-date room availability engine, guest lifetime stay ledger, and print-ready luxury guest billing folios.
full_desc: The Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites is an enterprise hospitality management and reservation ERP engineered for luxury hotels. Styled in a bespoke 75-80% Luxury White and Gold aesthetic with Navy architectural accents. Key capabilities include a 4-tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) security matrix (Administrator, General Manager, Front-Desk Receptionist, Housekeeper), an intelligent date-overlapping room availability engine preventing double-bookings, an interactive visual room inventory grid (Clean, Dirty, Occupied, Maintenance), a lifetime guest CRM directory, automated housekeeping turnover dispatch upon check-out, and itemized guest room folios with print-ready luxury invoices (@media print). Built on a 14-table relational database architecture.

title: Sakwa Canneries — Enterprise Factory ERP & Export Logistics
short_desc: Industrial food canning factory management platform coordinating produce intake, retort sterilizer batch scheduling, warehouse inventory, and international export dispatch.
full_desc: Sakwa Canneries & Exports (Pvt) Ltd Enterprise System is an industrial production management and logistics platform engineered to coordinate end-to-end operations at the Baddegama canning factory. The platform manages raw agricultural intake, automated retort sterilizer scheduling, batch quality control compliance, real-time inventory ledger balancing, and export customs shipment documentation. Engineered with modular PHP and relational MySQL infrastructure.

title: BMC Machine Center — Industrial Equipment & Invoicing System
short_desc: Java desktop industrial sewing machinery control system featuring machine catalogs, spare parts inventory, warranty tracking, and automated customer HTML invoicing.
full_desc: BMC Sewing Machine Center is an enterprise desktop software system developed with Java Swing and NetBeans GUI Builder. Built to oversee sales, servicing, and spare parts distribution for industrial garment machinery. Key components include a 200+ Swing component Dashboard with live machinery search, CRUD record controls, spare parts stock reconciliation, and warranty expiry tracking. Features an automated HTML/CSS print-ready invoice generation engine (Invoice_INV-*.html) and relational database integration via JDBC (bmc_machine_center.sql).

title: Gourmet POS — Restaurant Order & Automated Billing System
short_desc: High-efficiency Java desktop point-of-sale terminal with interactive table ordering, meal category touch panels, real-time bill calculations, and printable receipts.
full_desc: Gourmet POS is a point-of-sale and kitchen billing desktop application designed for fast-paced dining restaurants. Features an intuitive cashier terminal that computes sub-totals, service charges (10%), promotional discounts, and net bill amounts in real time. Incorporates dynamic food menu categories, table assignment dispatch, daily revenue analytics, top-selling dish counters, and printable thermal receipt formatting. Powered by Java and relational MySQL database backend (rest_bill_system.sql).

title: NexaSphere University — Academic & Admissions Portal
short_desc: Academic portal facilitating departmental course syllabi, campus computer lab overviews, and student online admission and registration processing.
full_desc: NexaSphere University is a higher education web portal built to connect prospective students with academic faculty curricula. It provides course catalogs with syllabus credit hours and prerequisite requirements, faculty department showcases, and a secure online student admission engine. The registration backend includes profile photo uploads, input sanitization, and database verification into MySQL (phpnexasphere_db.sql).
